text:
rajesh: Quick sync — ACME EdgeGuard listing wants SOC2 + pen artifacts uploaded to our presign bucket. Need to decide: who owns redaction (partner vs RW), retention TTL, and embargo lift timing for the joint announcement. Anyone take point?

claire (partner-ops): I can take redaction coordination for this integrator. 2 quick questions: do we accept partner-redacted reports or must RW do the final scrub? also need the presign TTL we should expose to partners. :thinking_face:

julian (security): We require Redwood to review final redactions for infra-sensitive items (HSM keys, internal IP, secrets). Partner can do initial redaction but must provide a redaction manifest (CSV) and original filenames. RW does final review and signs off.

julian (security): Redaction manifest should include: filename, redacted_fields, method, redactor_id, timestamp. If they can't produce that, we do full redaction here.

maria (si): For Edge integrations we can provide sanitized logs + config excerpts. Recommended artifact list to accept: 1) SOC2 attestation (pdf) 2) Pen-test executive summary (pdf, redacted) 3) Pen-test technical appendix (redacted) 4) Integration config snippets (sanitized) 5) Redaction manifest (csv).

kevin (legal): From legal: partners must sign the artifact holding addendum (one-pager) before we ingest non-public artifacts. Retention: legal prefers 3 years for audit trails, but for marketplace evidence we should do a short TTL for presigned uploads (<=90 days) and persist copies in the compliance vault only after exec approval. We'll need CAA (consent) checklist.

claire (partner-ops): Proposed flow: 1) Partner uploads to presigned URL (we enforce `upload --ttl 72h` by default) 2) Partner submits redaction manifest + attestations 3) RW performs final redaction review within 5 business days 4) If accepted, move artifacts to compliance vault (access-controlled) with retention TTL=3y, otherwise request resubmission. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

eng-ops-bot: FYI presign defaults: expires=72h. Use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/edgeguard.tar.gz --expires-in 259200`

claire (partner-ops): One more: for partners that need to redact onsite we can accept a notarized redaction report + screenshots of redaction tool run. julian — does security accept that evidence?

julian (security): Acceptable if the manifest + run logs show deterministic redaction. We need to verify sample pages (before/after) for at least 2 files. If automated tool used, include command line used. Example: ```redact-cli --input report.pdf --rules hw_pii.json --report redaction.csv```

maria (si): Implementation note: Edge SI bundles often contain IP-like config blobs. We'll create a small scrubber that strips all keys and hostnames by default and produce a sanitized copy. Can we surface that as a recommended partner script?

claire (partner-ops): Yes — I'll publish a Partner Redaction Recipe and a presign upload how-to by EOD tomorrow. I'll include the scrubber example and the required manifest CSV template.

kevin (legal): Also add clause that if partner refuses redaction audit we will withdraw listing. Need to include dispute escalation path and retention SLA in the partner addendum.

rajesh: OK assigning owners: claire = redaction & partner ops lead, julian = security reviewer, kevin = legal owner for addendum, maria = partner liaison for SI artifacts. I'll open a GH ticket for automation and a Confluence page for the process. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

claire (partner-ops): I'll post the RACI + link to the presign bucket when it's ready. tagging @julian @kevin for review once draft addendum is up.

maria (si): I'll prepare 2 sample sanitized bundles for security to review tomorrow.

julian (security): Will review samples within 24h once received.

eng-ops-bot: Reminder: presign upload logs are retained for 90 days in /audit/presign-uploads/ by default.

rajesh: Great — next check-in Friday EOD. If anyone needs to escalate earlier ping me directly.
